subject: AWS ACE enrollment & co-sell: timeline + security asks
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Wu <rachel.wu@amazon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-20T16:18:00Z
Subject: AWS ACE enrollment & co-sell: timeline + security asks

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the intro on the call last week. We're ready to start the ACE registration for Nimbus Health (pilot integration: Redwood Inference embedding/search for patient records anonymization). Two quick asks as we kick this off:

1) Can you confirm expected timeline for ACE listing (intake -> catalog listing -> co-sell handoff)? We want to align our internal roadmap and procurement windows.
2) On security/compliance: Nimbus has a SOC 2 Type II in process, but we can provide a summary. Are there any mandatory artifacts AWS needs before PDM/PSM will assist with listing?
3) Please introduce the assigned PDM/PSM on this thread and any intake forms I should fill out.

I've attached a draft marketplace catalog entry and our suggested bullet points for the co-sell pitch.

Attachments: marketplace-catalog-entry-draft.md (stub)

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior GTM Manager, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Rachel Wu <rachel.wu@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@amazon.com>, Tasha Green <tasha.green@amazon.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-21T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS ACE enrollment & co-sell: timeline + security asks

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the details. Looping in Samir (PDM) and Tasha (PSM) from AWS GTM to coordinate ACE intake and co-sell readiness. High level:

- Typical timeline: intake -> 2–3 weeks for ACE readiness review -> listing draft -> internal AWS approvals (2–4 weeks) -> catalog listing + co-sell enablement. Total commonly ~4–8 weeks depending on outstanding artifacts.
- Required artifacts: ACE intake form (I attached the spreadsheet), a short security summary (SOC 2 summary is fine), a 1-page partner pitch, and one reference customer or pilot plan.
- Next step: Camila, please complete the intake sheet and upload the security doc. Samir/Tasha will run the ACE readiness check and schedule a 30-min alignment call.

I've attached the intake spreadsheet and added a placeholder HubSpot record for tracking.

Attachments: aws-ace-intake-form.xlsx (stub)
Links: https://hubspot.amazon/ace-intake/ND-2028-0192

Best,
Rachel Wu
AWS GTM — Marketplace & Co-sell
rachel.wu@amazon.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@amazon.com>, Tasha Green <tasha.green@amazon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-21T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: AWS ACE enrollment & co-sell: timeline + security asks

Hi Samir / Tasha —

Welcome and thanks for jumping in. Quick context: Nimbus Health is an early adopter in our healthcare vertical — pilot to run embeddings + search over de-identified patient notes. We anticipate a $75k first-year ARR initial contract if we get co-sell support.

I've attached the draft marketplace catalog copy and a short SOC 2 summary from Nimbus (they're finalizing the report; summary included). Action items I propose:
- Camila to complete ACE intake (in progress) — target: EOD 4/22
- Samir/Tasha to perform readiness review and confirm gaps — target: 1 week after intake
- Laura/Kimberly to prepare sales one-pager and enablement for AWS field (Laura to own) — target: 4/28

Attachments: nimbus-soc2-summary.pdf (stub), marketplace-catalog-entry-draft.md (stub)

Camila
